metadata.title: Salasel — Learn with intention. Stay the course.
metadata.description: A focused learning platform with curated series, plus an optional browser extension that calms YouTube. They work together, and each stands on its own.

hero.headline: Learn with intention. Stay the course.

meaning.lead: The name holds both meanings: series that organise knowledge so you know where to begin, and chains that tie intention to practice so what you learn stays. That is what we build, for learning, awareness, and personal growth.
meaning.artworkAlt: A chain of interlocking links, lit in green, entering from the edge of the page.

app.lead: A place to return to instead of an endless feed: discover, focus, and keep your place.

points.discover: Discover curated series across education, awareness, and personal growth.
points.focus: Watch in a focused environment and track your progress.
points.keep: Bookmark what serves you and keep your own notes.
points.return: And always return to a clear learning path.

screens.home: The Salasel app home screen showing a library of curated learning series.
screens.series: A series detail page listing the episodes within it.
screens.player: A focused player with a side notes panel.

extension.lead: Keep watching on YouTube. The extension hides only what you choose, holds your notes, and keeps a way back to your series.

points.choose: Turn off distractions one by one. Nothing is hidden until you switch it on.
points.notes: Keep your own notes on each video.
points.resume: See a card that brings you back to your Salasel series.

extension.note: The extension is optional. You do not need it to use Salasel or YouTube.
extension.screenAlt: The Salasel extension open on a YouTube video, with distraction toggles and a notes panel.

flow.keyline: Learn where you prefer. Stay connected to what matters.

choose.title: Choose
choose.text: Pick a meaningful series in Salasel and set your direction.

watch.title: Watch
watch.text: Follow it inside Salasel, or continue the same series on YouTube.

stay.title: Stay on track
stay.text: On YouTube, the extension quiets the distractions you choose and keeps a way back to your series.

shots.choose: A Salasel series page listing its episodes with progress checkboxes.
shots.stay: The Salasel extension open on YouTube, tracking your series progress with a button back to Salasel.

watchChoice.label: Watch inside Salasel or continue the same series on YouTube

flow.chainAlt: A chain of interlocking links, lit in green, connecting each step of the flow.

privacy.lead: No account to create, nothing to track. What stays private stays with you, and what we build stays open to read.

noTracking.title: No account, no tracking
noTracking.text: No sign-up, no analytics, and no sale of your data. Ever.

onDevice.title: Kept in your browser
onDevice.text: Your learning progress, preferences, and notes stay in your browser.

sync.title: Sync you control
sync.text: Extension preferences may use your browser account's sync, controlled by you. We cannot access that data.

feedback.title: Only what you send
feedback.text: Feedback is transmitted only when you choose to submit it.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.text: The project's source is open. Read it, verify it, or build on it.
